messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — autoscaler unable to provision GPU capacity in aws-ap-southeast-3. AWS API returning ServiceQuotaExceeded for G-family instances. Impact: realtime-infer queue growth and client 504s. See runbook: /runbooks/gpu-autoscale-quota

 tia (ops-oncall): Acknowledged. Taking triage. Omar, paste autoscaler and ASG errors?

 omar (eng-sre): Autoscaler log excerpt:
 ```
 2026-03-15T09:14:02Z autoscaler error: LaunchFailed - ServiceQuotaExceeded: quota exceeded for g5 family in ap-southeast-3
 ```
 Also seeing many pods Pending with "Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu" in `kubectl describe` output.

 kai (eng-runtime): ASG: inference-apse3-gpu-asg (launch-template lt-infer-2025). Attempting +8 nodes; AWS rejecting 6 of 8. realtime-infer pending queue: 130 -> 560 in ~9m. p95 latency up to 2.3s, error rate ~6%.

 marta (support): Customer impact: acct-3311 and acct-7790 reporting embeddings timeouts and failed batch jobs. Marked acct-3311 as SEV2 per SLA. Sending initial templated notice now.

 dena (product): Can we failover SEV2 customers to eu-west-1 or us-west-2? Need latency and capacity numbers.

 kai (eng-runtime): eu-west-1 has ~38% spare on dedicated pools (lower for spot); us-west-2 ~22%. eu-west-1 adds ~150-220ms tail latency for those customers. We can route per-customer via Console route weights.

 tia (ops-oncall): Immediate mitigations: 
 - divert 15%-30% of SEV2 customer traffic to eu-west-1
 - reduce route max_batch_size and max_concurrency
 - enable CPU-fallback tiny model for non-critical traffic
 - open AWS service-quota case and escalate via premium support

 omar (eng-sre): Opened AWS case CASE-APSE3-4521. Uploaded AMI IDs, instance types, and traffic graphs. AWS acknowledged; SE team engaged. No firm ETA yet.

 kai (eng-runtime): Pushing canary route override (10%) to reduce batch sizes:
 ```
 route.realtime-infer.override {
   max_batch_size: 12 -> 6
   max_concurrency: 10 -> 4
 }
 ```
 Canary now live.

 tia (ops-oncall): Omar, switch routing 20% for acct-3311 and acct-7790 to eu-west-1. Kai, monitor canary and ramp if stable.

 omar (eng-sre): Routing flipped. Observed error reduction for those accounts within ~90s. Global pending queue growth slowed: 560 -> 470.

 kai (eng-runtime): Canary metrics stable. Planning to ramp override to 30% in 5m if no regressions.

 marta (support): Sent customer updates to acct-3311 and acct-7790; they requested ETA. We replied with mitigation steps and next update in 15m.

 omar (eng-sre): Added mixed-instance (spot) fallback to ASG launch template as a temporary measure. Spot supply in ap-southeast-3 is thin; some launches still fail due to quota.

 tia (ops-oncall): If AWS ETA > 90 minutes, plan B: provision emergency dedicated pool in eu-west-1 and migrate SEV2 customers. Finance approval required for overspend. @finance please standby.

 dena (product): Approve emergency spend up to $20k for critical workloads. Provide rollback criteria.

 omar (eng-sre): AWS update: "Investigating quota increase request; SE team engaged. No ETA." Uploaded concurrent launch stats and AMI details.

 kai (eng-runtime): Snapshot T+35m: pending queue 470 -> 350, p95 latency improved 2.3s -> 1.4s, error rate 6% -> 2.5%. Routing + batch reductions + spot fallback are helping but this is not fully resolved.

 tia (ops-oncall): Good progress. Handoff plan: Omar remains incident lead for next 90m; Kai handles runtime config changes; Marta covers customer comms. If unresolved after 2h escalate to execs. Creating incident INC-20260315-0953.

 omar (eng-sre): Follow-ups to add to incident ticket: 1) request permanent quota bump for ap-southeast-3, 2) add autoscaler fallback-region policy, 3) pre-warm capacity playbook, 4) add headroom alerts for GPU pools. Also schedule a cross-region failover test.

 marta (support): Customers acknowledged. acct-3311 asked for frequency of updates; we'll send next update in 20m.

 tia (ops-oncall): Leaving this thread open for handoff. Ping here if you take over. Incident document: /incidents/2026-03-15-apse3-quota-stall

 participants: incident-bot, tia (ops-oncall), omar (eng-sre), kai (eng-runtime), marta (support), dena (product), finance
